title: Analytics Settings
description: Configure tracking for your organization's conversion analytics.

publishable_key.title: Publishable Key
publishable_key.description: Use this key in your client-side SDK to track conversions. Keep it secure but note it will be visible in client-side code.
publishable_key.regenerate_warning: This will invalidate your current key immediately. Any tracking using the old key will stop working. This action cannot be undone.

snippet.title: Installation Snippet
snippet.description: Choose your preferred integration method to start tracking conversions.

allowed_hostnames.title: Allowed Hostnames
allowed_hostnames.description: Only tracking requests from these domains will be accepted.
allowed_hostnames.empty: No hostnames configured. Add a hostname to enable tracking.
allowed_hostnames.add_description: Enter a hostname to allow tracking requests from.
allowed_hostnames.remove_description: Tracking requests from {{hostname}} will no longer be accepted.

errors.invalid_hostname: Please enter a valid hostname (e.g., example.com or *.example.com)

tag_installation.title: Install the tracking tag
tag_installation.subtitle: Add the Li2 Analytics script to your website to start tracking.
tag_installation.wordpress_detected: WordPress detected — we've switched to the WordPress installation guide.
tag_installation.auto_collect_title: What do you want to collect automatically?
tag_installation.auto_collect_subtitle: Toggle the options to customize your snippet — the code below updates in real time. Copy it again after making changes.
tag_installation.pageview_desc: Track when visitors navigate to a new page
tag_installation.clicks_desc: Track all link and button clicks
tag_installation.scroll_desc: Track how far visitors scroll on each page
tag_installation.forms_desc: Track when visitors interact with or submit forms
tag_installation.verify_subtitle: Once you've added the script, verify it's working correctly.

tour.title: Take a tour
tour.subtitle: Explore what you can track with Li2 Analytics. Open any guide to see code examples.
tour.conversion_desc: Track leads and sales to measure attribution
tour.heatmap_desc: See where users click and how far they scroll
tour.funnel_coming_desc: The setup guide for Funnel Analysis is on its way. In the meantime, you can explore funnels directly.

conversion.subtitle: Track when a user becomes a lead or completes a purchase to measure conversion attribution.
conversion.server_key_info: Server-side tracking requires a secret API key (starts with li2_sk_). Generate one below — it will be shown once, so copy it right away.
conversion.debug_empty: Enable debug mode to see incoming events
conversion.woo_no_info: Without WooCommerce, use the HTTP API to track conversions directly from PHP — no plugin or SDK required.
conversion.wp_site_hint_detected: Detected from Tag Installation step — you can override it here.
conversion.wp_site_hint_default: Select from your allowed domains or type a custom URL.
conversion.wp_auto_desc: We open your plugin settings and push the configuration automatically.
conversion.wp_dialog_desc_existing: We'll push your existing API key to the plugin and enable the selected WooCommerce events automatically.
conversion.wp_dialog_desc_new: We'll create a new secret API key for WooCommerce and push it to your plugin along with the selected events.
conversion.wp_step_generate_key_suffix: — you'll need it to connect the plugin
conversion.wp_step_paste_key: Paste your secret key into the API Key field and enable Integrate with WooCommerce on the same page

heatmap.subtitle: Heatmap and interaction data is collected automatically — no extra code needed once the tag is installed.
heatmap.before_start_desc: Enable these options in the Tag Installation step — once on, data flows in with no extra code.
heatmap.pageviews_desc: Visited URLs and referrers tracked on every navigation
heatmap.clicks_desc: Element coordinates, tag, text, and page path on every click
heatmap.scroll_desc: How far visitors scroll on each page, per session
heatmap.debug_empty: Enable debug mode to see incoming events

funnel.subtitle: Track user progression through multi-step flows. Use consistent funnelName values across steps to group them in the analytics dashboard.
funnel.tip_1: Use the same funnelName for all steps in a flow
funnel.tip_2: Steps should be sequential integers starting from 1
funnel.tip_3: Keep stepName values consistent across sessions

server_side.subtitle: Use the server SDK to track conversions from your backend — ideal for payment webhooks, form submissions, and any server-side event.
server_side.prerequisites_desc: You need a secret API key (starts with li2_sk_). Create one in Settings → API Keys.

http_api.subtitle: Track conversions from any platform — WordPress, PHP, Python, Ruby — via direct HTTP requests. No SDK required.
http_api.auth_desc: Your secret API key — server-side only, never expose to clients
http_api.note_click_id: click_id — the Li2 click ID read from the li_cid cookie
http_api.note_id_required: Either click_id or external_id is required for lead tracking
http_api.note_sale_required: click_id is required for sale tracking (attribution)
